title: Sarah Boone Arrest – Body-Worn Camera, Interview and 911 Records (Case closed, sentenced 12/02/2024)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

Incident date: February 23–24, 2020
Individual involved: Sarah Boone, arrested February 24, 2020
Victim: Jorge Torres Jr.
Location: Frantz Lane (Winter Park area), Orange County, Florida
Case status: Closed. Sarah Boone was convicted of second-degree murder on October 25, 2024 and sentenced to life in prison on December 2, 2024 (Ninth Judicial Circuit, Orange County).

Specifically, I request:
- Complete body-worn camera (BWC) footage from every OCSO deputy who responded to the residence on February 24, 2020, and who participated in or documented the arrest of Sarah Boone.
- All recorded interviews/interrogations of Sarah Boone conducted by OCSO detectives.
- The 911 call audio placed by Sarah Boone on February 24, 2020, and the CAD/dispatch report.
- All dash-camera/in-car video from vehicles involved.
- The incident/offense report, arrest affidavit and supplemental reports.
- The booking photograph.

Please provide video in its original electronic format and highest available quality. If portions are exempt, please provide all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions and cite the statutory basis for any redaction. If versions of these recordings were previously released to the media, those versions are acceptable.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Otabek Tolaganov
